Plot citation network

Source: R/plot-citation-net.R
sm_plot_citation_network.Rd

Visualise the citation network of top-cited works.

Usage

sm_plot_citation_network(corpus, top_n = 50L, dark = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

corpus

An sm_corpus.

top_n

Number of top works to include.

dark

Logical; dark mode?

...

Additional arguments.

Value

A ggplot object.

See also

Other plots: autoplot.sm_corpus(), sm_palette_qualitative(), sm_plot_bradford(), sm_plot_collab(), sm_plot_equity_dashboard(), sm_plot_evolution(), sm_plot_heaps(), sm_plot_landscape(), sm_plot_lotka(), sm_plot_production(), sm_plot_thematic_map(), sm_plot_top(), sm_scale_color(), sm_theme()
